# orion server

The server the app and agents talk to

```sh
orion server <command> [options]
```

## orion server start

Serve the Orion API for the app and agents

```sh
orion server start [options]
```

| Argument             | Description                                                    |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--port <value>`     | HTTP port (default 5198)                                       |
| `--host <value>`     | HTTP host (default 127.0.0.1)                                  |
| `--static <value>`   | Built app directory                                            |
| `--dev-port <value>` | Port of the app's dev server, whose requests are also answered |

## orion server status

Report the running Orion server

```sh
orion server status [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |
